game.splendor.name: Splendor
game.splendor.desc: Gather gem tokens, buy development cards and win the favour of the nobles. When a player reaches fifteen points the round is played out and the richest merchant takes the match.
game.splendor.rule.1: Take gem tokens or reserve a card, then spend tokens to buy development cards that give permanent gem bonuses.
game.splendor.rule.2: Nobles visit players with the required bonuses. At fifteen points the round finishes and the highest score wins.
game.splendor.option.target_points_hint: The match ends after the round in which a player reaches this many points.
game.splendor.option.nobles_hint: When on, the first player to meet a noble's card bonuses receives it and its points.

game.splendor.reason_deadlock: Nobody can move any more; the highest score wins.
game.splendor.reason_tie: Two players tie on points and cards: the match is a draw.
